guidebook.intro: Yogera ku kusaba, ku naku enkulu, era owe abantu emikisa mu Lungereza.

tips.title: To church, to the mosque
body: Okugenda okusaba: **I go to church** (awatali **the**) ne **he goes to the mosque**. Ku lunaku: **on Sunday**, **on Friday**.

tips.title: Okulamusa ku naku enkulu
body: **Happy Christmas!** oba **Merry Christmas!** **Happy New Year! Happy Easter! Happy Eid!** oba **Eid Mubarak!**
Okudamu: **You too!** oba **The same to you!**

tips.title: Emikisa
body: **Katonda akuwe omukisa** kiba **God bless you!** Okudamu: **Amen.** oba **Thank you.**

culture.title: Olunaku lw’Abajulizi
body: **Martyrs Day is on 3 June.** Abantu bangi okuva mu Uganda ne mu nsi endala batambula okugenda e Namugongo.
